rules.wordmarkCasing: Strictly uppercase: VOOO LABS. Never Vooo Labs or VOOO-LABS.
rules.eyebrows: Always JetBrains Mono, uppercase, letter-spacing +0.14em to +0.18em
rules.headings: Inter font-bold (700) or font-extrabold (800) with tracking -0.02em to -0.03em

safeZones.instagramStory: Top and bottom 250px clear of primary text
safeZones.linkedinCover: Bottom-left 200px x 100px clear for profile photo overlap

do: Keep clear space equal to the height of the letter 'V' around the wordmark.
Use high-contrast monochromatic typography against clean dark or light surfaces.
Anchor layouts with structured engineering cards and precise technical labels.
Maintain authentic CrazyBlocks font for the logo mark.
dont: Do NOT use generic neon or cyberpunk glows.
Do NOT alter the wordmark aspect ratio or letterforms.
Do NOT clutter social cards with long paragraphs or stock illustrations.
Do NOT add fake phone numbers or promotional clutter on brand banners.
